author: SKIZZOO
short: Red-DiscordBot cog for continuous JuiceVault playback.
description: Fetches the JuiceVault Music archive and continuously plays it in a Discord voice channel, reloading the archive at the end.
install_msg: Install FFmpeg on the Red host, then load the cog and use [p]jv start while you are in a voice channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no personal user data.
